description: List suppressed recipients. Each entry has a reason (hard_bounce, complaint, soft_bounce or manual), a scope (all blocks every send; marketing blocks newsletter sends only) and expires_at (null when permanent; soft-bounce pauses last 30 days).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous call.

scope.description: Only entries with this scope. `all` entries block every send; `marketing` entries come from newsletter complaints and block newsletter sends only.

name: shipmail_list_suppressions
title: List Suppressions
